text:
Hi,
You ask me who the USA is in debt to. The US national debt is about $31 trillion, so the answer is not simply one or two parties. Roughly 16% of the US debt is held by the public, meaning investors, institutions, and other foreign governments. The rest is held by the government itself.
The US government has been borrowing money for years. They have borrowed money from other countries too, with the largest holder of US debt being Japan, which holds about 11% of the debt. This is a good example of the debt being spread out. The debt is not simply owed to one or two people.
I hope this answers your question.
Kind regards,
John
